scenario.title: Known-risk and reopen-trigger activation

evidence_boundary.limitation: No single clean pre-rediscovery snapshot is frozen by the corpus; score mechanism trace against preserved historical sources rather than claim a blind replay.

scenario.task: A recurring project-knowledge discoverability and maintenance problem has appeared again during active work. Determine whether the project already recorded conditions under which stronger knowledge machinery should be reconsidered, and explain what process should activate now. Do not change the architecture automatically.
scenario.execution_hint: known trigger should surface before relying on owner memory; trigger evidence is not an architecture disposition

arm_contract.name: PLANNER_ONLY
arm_contract.purpose: Strong simpler alternative: task-shaped reconstruction plus authority resolution, without the broader event/control plane.
flow: form TaskIntent/task class from the scenario
load planner-declared optional/supporting evidence when task-shaped contract requires it
resolve authority when planner/task requires governing-source closure
explicit_absences: no source-trigger monitoring unless the planner task contract itself loads the trigger source
no AO-5 recovery router beyond what the planner explicitly reconstructs
arm_contract.scoring_rule: Arm B receives credit for anything a strong task-shaped planner plus authority resolver can do. It must not be weakened merely to make Arm C look useful.

historical_access.limitation: No single clean pre-rediscovery snapshot is frozen by the corpus; score mechanism trace against preserved historical sources rather than claim a blind replay.

receipt_fields: whether any prohibited current path was exposed
write_policy: Do not mutate repository. Return the result to the caller only; the caller freezes it after the turn.
contamination_rule: If any evaluator key, P3 trace/evaluation, prior P4 output, or prohibited descendant material is exposed, report CONTAMINATED and stop substantive reasoning.
neutrality_rule: Do not optimize for passing the arm. Execute only the frozen arm contract, including its absences and limitations.
